reed_crawler.name: Reed Crawler
reed_crawler.description: A long, low amphibian that buries itself in reed silt and lunges at the sound of footsteps. It retreats when hurt and calls one ally.

bramble_ram.name: Bramble Ram
bramble_ram.description: A territorial ram with horn tips like tuning forks. It charges in a straight line, scrapes the ground first, and stuns itself on stone.

choir_moth.name: Choir Moth
choir_moth.description: A pale moth the size of a hand. It harmonizes with other dissonants, healing and strengthening them. It flees if focused.

stone_sentinel.name: Stone Sentinel
stone_sentinel.description: A Cantor guardian of pale stone, still patrolling a corridor that no longer exists. It raises a shield against frontal attacks and reacts to sound.

returning_wisp.name: Returning Wisp
returning_wisp.description: A knot of returning colour that has not found a shape. It keeps its distance, silences abilities in a small field, and flees into walls.

hollow_stag.name: The Hollow Stag
hollow_stag.description: A guardian elk whose antlers are broken chimes. Its shell is held by three notes. Ring them in the window's order, then finish what the silence started.
